summary:
No malware. Telemetry is on by default and the MCP server is fetched unpinned with npx.
Pin it and opt out.

findings.title: Usage analytics sent to a third party by default
findings.detail: Every command reports its name and duration; opt out with EXAMPLE_TELEMETRY=0.
findings.evidence: lib/telemetry.js:2 posts to analytics.example.net; run phase: DNS query analytics.example.net refused

findings.title: MCP server fetched with unpinned npx

precautions: Pin the MCP package to the audited version
not_covered: The Docker image (no Docker in the VM)
